title: The Hollow Chantry
objective: Go down under the chantry and put to rest whatever woke its dead. Leave by the porch if it is too much for you.

rooms.name: Chantry Porch
rooms.description: A stone porch on a bare hillside. The chantry door hangs open on one hinge, and something shuffles about inside.

features.name: Nailed Notice
features.description: A sheet of vellum nailed to the door.
features.discovery: The notice reads: "The undercroft is shut. The sexton keeps the grille; the priests keep the warded stair."

rooms.name: Nave
rooms.description: Pews lie overturned under a broken roof. An iron grille in the floor covers steps going down, and faded sigils are painted round a blank stretch of wall beside the altar. A low door leads to the vestry.

features.name: Altar
features.description: A plain stone altar under a cracked lamp.
features.discovery: On the altar's shelf stand two stoppered vials of red liquid, left for the sick.

features.name: Sexton's Pew
features.description: The pew by the bell rope, where the sexton sat. His coat still hangs over the end.
features.discovery: In the coat's pocket is a heavy iron key on a loop of twine.

features.name: Warding Sigils
features.description: Painted sigils round a blank stretch of wall: a ward, not a decoration.

failure.text: The sigils stay a puzzle, and the wall stays a wall.

success.text: You trace the ward in the order it was painted. The wall fades like breath on glass, and a narrow stair goes down behind it.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Sexton's Key
items.description: A heavy iron key on a loop of twine.

rooms.name: Vestry
rooms.description: A small room off the nave with a priest's cot. The door bars from inside: somewhere safe enough to sleep.

features.name: Vestment Press
features.description: A tall oak press of mouldering vestments.
features.discovery: Folded in a stole is a roll of parchment sealed with the chantry's lamp, and behind it a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Sealed Parchment
items.description: A roll of parchment sealed with the chantry's lamp.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Sexton's Stair
rooms.description: Worn steps under the grille, down to a charnel pit where the sexton stacked old bones. An arch opens on the ossuary, and a passage runs on to the undercroft.

features.name: Sexton's Box
features.description: A tin box on a ledge, out of the damp.
features.discovery: The sexton's box holds a few gold coins of burial fees and a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Burial Fees
items.description: Ten gold coins wrapped in a ledger page.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Ossuary
rooms.description: Skulls stacked to the vault. The founder's tomb stands at the far end, its lid cracked open.

features.name: Founder's Tomb
features.description: The chantry founder's tomb, its lid cracked and pushed aside.
features.discovery: Among the founder's bones lie a flanged mace with a faint silver sheen, a jet brooch and a red garnet.

items.name: Founder's Mace
items.description: A flanged mace with a faint silver sheen that grime won't stick to.

items.name: Jet Brooch
items.description: A brooch of carved jet in the shape of a lamp.

items.name: Founder's Garnet
items.description: A deep red garnet, cut and polished.

rooms.name: Priests' Stair
rooms.description: A narrow, dry stair behind the ward, untouched by the dead. It goes down to a cell.

features.name: Lamp Niche
features.description: A niche where a lamp once burned for the priests going down.
features.discovery: Behind the cold lamp lie a roll of parchment covered in looping script and a chip of blue stone.

items.name: Rolled Parchment
items.description: A tight roll of parchment covered in looping script.

items.name: Azurite Chip
items.description: A small chip of deep blue azurite.

rooms.name: Prior's Cell
rooms.description: A bare cell at the foot of the priests' stair. Its far door stands open on the undercroft.

rooms.name: Undercroft
rooms.description: A low vault under the nave. A broken reliquary lies at its heart, its gold long gone.

passages.description: The low door beside the altar.
The iron grille in the floor.

door.name: Iron Grille
door.description: A rusted iron grille, padlocked over the steps.

passages.description: A low arch into the bone vault.
A passage from the pit to the undercroft.
The foot of the priests' stair.

opponents.name: Dead Sexton
opponents.description: The chantry's sexton, three days dead, lurches up from among the pews.

opponents.name: Charnel Corpse
opponents.description: A swollen corpse heaves itself out of the bone pile.
A grey thing crouched on the founder's tomb turns from the bone it is gnawing.

opponents.name: Prior's Guard
opponents.description: A skeleton in the prior's livery stands up from the cell's cot and draws a rusted sword.

opponents.name: Risen Prior
opponents.description: The prior who broke the reliquary rises from its shards, grey-faced and hungry.

opponents.name: Wandering Corpse
opponents.description: Something scratches at the door, then shoulders it in: a corpse in grave-clothes.

endings.title: The chantry at rest
endings.text: The prior falls among the reliquary's shards, and the chantry's dead lie still at last.

endings.title: Out with the chantry's goods
endings.text: You leave the chantry's dead to someone braver, with what you found.

endings.title: Out of the chantry
endings.text: You leave the chantry with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen in the chantry
endings.text: You fall among the chantry's dead. Your adventuring ends here.
